map.目标时间 = 源时间 − 源时区偏移 × 60 + 目标时区偏移 × 60（单位: Target time = source time − source offset × 60 + target offset × 60 (in minutes); days crossed = floor(result ÷ 1440), minute of the day = result taken modulo 1440 and normalized to 0-1439, then split into hours and minutes. This tool uses the fixed standard offsets shown in the selectors and does not judge daylight saving; during daylight saving, rely on the local official clock.
map.固定偏移：按下拉中的标准偏移换算，不含夏令时。: Fixed offset: converts with the standard offset shown in the selector; daylight saving is not included.
map.本工具不判断夏令时，按固定标准偏移换算；夏令时期间请以当地官方时钟为准。: This tool does not judge daylight saving and converts with a fixed standard offset; during daylight saving, rely on the local official clock.
map.时区与标准偏移取自 IANA 时区库主要城市定义，本工具未接入实时规则。: Time zones and standard offsets come from the major-city definitions of the IANA time zone database; no live rule lookup is performed.
map.📚 深度解析：在内置时区之间按固定标准偏移换算时间、计算时差并标注跨日天数，辅助: 📚 In-depth: converts time between built-in zones using fixed standard offsets, computes time differences and marks day changes for cross-border scheduling.
map.示例：按标准偏移，北京 20:00 对应伦敦 12:00（差 8h）；本工具不判: Example: using standard offsets, 20:00 in Beijing corresponds to 12:00 in London (8h apart); daylight saving is not judged.
